title: Spend is attributed to the item and to the kb topic or code module it served, ranked by topic, and exported to OpenTelemetry
goal: A usage record carries, beside its item, the kb articles its kb_show and kb_facts calls named and the repository files its Read, Edit and Grep calls opened, which the store's usage sidecars keep; backlog.py cost --by topic|module ranks spend and tokens for each kb article and each repository file from the query log's usage sidecars; the metrics export adds a topic attribute to the day's cost points, beside the item attribute the claim spend points carry, so any OpenTelemetry backend shows cost per item and per topic; the ranking names the costliest topics and modules as the next research or mapping targets.

import datetime,json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
R=os.getcwd();T=os.path.join(R,"_tools");d=Path(os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()));n=chr(10)
def transcript(name,tools,out):
    recs=[{"type":"user","promptId":"p1","sessionId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","cwd":R,"message":{"role":"user","content":"q"}}]
    blocks=[{"type":"tool_use","id":"t%d"%i,"name":nm,"input":inp} for i,(nm,inp) in enumerate(tools)]
    recs.append({"type":"assistant","requestId":"r1","promptId":"p1","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","usage":{"input_tokens":1000,"output_tokens":out,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0},"content":blocks}})
    recs.append({"type":"user","promptId":"p1","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"t%d"%i,"content":"x"} for i in range(len(tools))]}})
    recs.append({"type":"assistant","requestId":"r2","promptId":"p1","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","usage":{"input_tokens":1200,"output_tokens":10,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"a"}]}})
    p=d/(name+".jsonl");p.write_text(n.join(json.dumps(r) for r in recs)+n);return p
BIG=transcript("big",[("mcp__kb__kb_show",{"path":"intune/enrollment.md:12"}),("Read",{"file_path":os.path.join(R,"_tools","kbusage.py")})],90000)
SMALL=transcript("small",[("mcp__kb__kb_pack",{"question":"dsc"}),("mcp__kb__kb_facts",{"prefix":"dsc/cli-reference"}),("Grep",{"pattern":"x","path":os.path.join(R,"_tools","kbmon.py")})],50)
def record(p):
    r=s.run([sys.executable,T+"/kbusage.py",str(p),"--prompt","p1"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    try:return json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    except (ValueError,IndexError):print(r.stdout[-300:],r.stderr[-300:]);return {}
def store(root,day):
    run=day.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")+"-aaaaaaaa";m=day.strftime("%Y-%m")
    (root/m).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(root/"usage"/m).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    ents=[("e1",BIG),("e2",SMALL)]
    (root/m/(run+".jsonl")).write_text(json.dumps({"run":run,"pipeline":5,"retrieval":5,"counts":{"entries":2}})+n+n.join(json.dumps({"id":e,"day":day.date().isoformat(),"surface":"cli"}) for e,_ in ents)+n)
    (root/"usage"/m/(run+".jsonl")).write_text(json.dumps({"run":run,"reader":1,"counts":{"entries":2,"missing":0}})+n+n.join(json.dumps(dict({"id":e},**{k:v for k,v in record(p).items() if k!="prompt"})) for e,p in ents)+n)
def cost(*a):
    code="import sys;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import ql_base;ql_base.STORE=Path(sys.argv[2]);import runpy;sys.argv=[sys.argv[1]+'/backlog.py']+sys.argv[3:];runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
    r=s.run([sys.executable,"-c",code,T,str(d/"store"),"cost",*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300);print(r.returncode,r.stdout[-800:],r.stderr[-300:]);return r
a=json.dumps(record(BIG));b=json.dumps(record(SMALL));print(a[:400],b[:400])
ok=all(x in a for x in ("intune/enrollment","_tools/kbusage.py")) and all(x in b for x in ("dsc/cli-reference","_tools/kbmon.py"))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

backlog.py cost --by topic|module ranks spend and tokens for each kb article and each repository file from the query log's usage sidecars

gates.question: How is a prompt's cost attributed when it names several kb articles or files?
options: shared evenly over the names, so the ranking adds up to the prompts' cost
the whole prompt cost to each name
gates.recommendation: shared evenly over the names, so the ranking adds up to the prompts' cost
gates.answer: shared evenly over the names, so the ranking adds up to the prompts' cost

gates.question: How many topic points does the day's cost export carry?
options: the day's total and the costliest 20 topics
one point for every topic of the day
gates.recommendation: the day's total and the costliest 20 topics
gates.answer: the day's total and the costliest 20 topics

gates.question: Does the usage reader version change for the new topics and files fields?
options: the reader version stays, the fields are optional and older records count in no ranking
the reader version is raised so every prompt is read again
gates.recommendation: the reader version stays, the fields are optional and older records count in no ranking
gates.answer: the reader version stays, the fields are optional and older records count in no ranking

gates.question: May a metric attribute value start with an underscore, so a kb article of the _self root keeps its topic point?
options: yes, the first character may be an underscore
no, a topic starting with an underscore leaves its point out
gates.recommendation: yes, the first character may be an underscore
gates.answer: yes, the first character may be an underscore
